pages.title: Installation and licence
pages.lead: Install the Pro add-on and activate your licence.

steps.text: The Pro add-on, from ilmtech.in, is installed the same way: Add New Plugin, Upload Plugin, choose its zip, and Install Now. Pro adds Find my size, the AI builder and five more themes.
Activate it. To upgrade later, upload the new zip the same way and choose Replace current with uploaded: your size charts and settings are kept.
Open the Size Charts menu. Pro asks for your licence: paste the order ID from your ilmtech.in order e-mail and click Activate. It turns on updates, support and the AI.
Remind me later closes the window. The bar keeps the Enter licence button for later.
The size chart list is still empty. Add Size Chart makes your first chart; with an active licence, Create with AI is there too. The next videos show how.

pages.title: AI settings
pages.lead: Choose which AI creates and changes your size charts.
pages.intro: In this video: the AI settings of the ILM Size Chart Pro add-on.

steps.text: On the size chart list, click AI Settings. The green dot shows that the AI is ready.
ILM Tech AI is built in: no key is needed.
With an activated licence you get free AI requests. Each size chart created by AI uses one. The Pro plan gives more requests every month.
You can also use your own account with Anthropic Claude, DeepSeek or Google Gemini: choose it, paste your key, pick a model, and test the connection.
We keep the built-in AI and close the window. The next videos use it to create and change a chart.

pages.title: Create with AI
pages.lead: A complete size chart in three steps.
pages.intro: In this video: Create with AI, a feature of the Pro add-on. A complete size chart in three easy steps.

steps.text: On the size chart list, click Create with AI. Three easy steps, and you check the result before anything is saved.
Step one: what is the chart for? We choose Pants and jeans.
Who is it for: Men and Women. With two groups you get one tab per group.
Below, you see what the AI will make: the sizes, the measurements and the units. Each can be changed.
Next. Step two: pick a look. We choose Indigo Denim. A tick can style the size guide button and the popup to match.
Next. Step three: name it. Create uses one AI request.
Click Create. After a moment the chart is ready: men and women tabs, with real sizes and measurements in centimetres and inches.
Open in editor puts it in a new chart form. Check the values, change anything in the designer, add a display rule, and save.
Nothing is saved until you click Save, so you can try again or start over at any time.

pages.title: AI design assistant
pages.lead: Change your chart by typing what you want.
pages.intro: In this video: the AI design assistant of the Pro add-on, which changes a chart from one sentence.

steps.text: Edit a chart and open the designer. The green button at the bottom right is the AI design assistant.
Click it. Type what you want to change, in your own words. You can also attach a picture of a chart to copy.
We ask: make the table header dark green, and add a row for the number of pages.
Send. The assistant answers and changes the chart in the designer: a green header and a Pages row.
Not what you wanted? Undo takes it back. Save the chart to keep the change.

pages.title: Find my size
pages.lead: Shoppers get their size from your chart, with a fit explanation.
pages.intro: In this video: Find my size, a feature of the Pro add-on. Shoppers type their measurements, or their height and weight, and get the right size from your chart.

steps.text: Edit a chart. On the General tab, Find my size is enabled for every new chart. There is nothing to set up: it reads the chart.
Below the switch you see what shoppers will be asked, taken from the measurement names in your table: here chest, waist and collar.
In the shop, the shirt now has a Find my size button next to the size chart button.
The shopper clicks it and chooses: measure with a tape, or a quick estimate from height and weight.
With the tape: they type their chest, 100 centimetres, and their waist, 94. Every field they can leave empty is optional.
The result: size M, and why: how each measurement fits that size.
One click chooses size M on the product, and the button now says: your size, M. The size is remembered on other products too.
In the size chart, the M column is marked for this shopper.

Opened again, it shows the result straight away. Forget my measurements clears them. The quick estimate asks only height and weight. It is offered for clothes; for rings or shoes, a tape measurement is needed.
To hide it for one chart, click Disable here and save. Charts without body measurements, like mugs or posters, never show the button.

pages.title: Pro themes
pages.lead: The five themes the Pro add-on adds, and how to use a theme.
pages.intro: In this video: themes. Ready-made looks for your size chart.

steps.text: Edit the chart, open the designer, and click Themes. Every card shows a sample table in that theme.
Each theme has two buttons. Apply to my tables gives your own tables this look. Add as new row adds a complete sample block in this theme.
We click Apply to my tables on Midnight. A bar asks to confirm, and says how many tables change.
Yes. The table has the Midnight colours; its content and units are kept.
Not happy? One click on Undo takes the whole theme back.
We keep it and save. The shop shows the new look.
The option Also style the popup button and window, in the themes window, matches the button to the theme too.

pages.title: Privacy and external services
pages.lead: Which external services the Pro add-on uses and what is sent to them.

pages.title: Deactivate and delete
pages.lead: Switch the Pro add-on off, or remove it.

steps.text: Then open Plugins. Start with the Pro add-on.
Click Deactivate. Pro is off, and your charts stay as they are. Deactivate only, if you just want to switch it off for a while.
Deactivate ILM Size Chart too. The shop no longer shows any size chart, but nothing is deleted yet.
Delete removes a plugin with its files. Delete the Pro add-on first: WordPress keeps ILM Size Chart until the add-on that needs it is gone.
Click Delete and confirm. The Pro add-on is deleted.
